A lot is happening on @kamino

→Open security

all_tweets.description:
A lot is happening on @kamino  

→Institutional rails 
→Consumer yield 
→Open security 
→Developer distribution 

Let's take a look

•Atlas Collateral Management with Anchorage Digital

Kamino is piloting @Anchorage Atlas Collateral Management, a 24/7 automated system for institutional credit with real-time monitoring, automated margin calls, and liquidation infrastructure inside a regulated custody environment. 

In plain terms: institutions can now participate in Kamino's onchain credit markets without moving their assets out of regulated custody. The collateral stays where it is. The loan happens onchain. Atlas watches it round the clock.

•Marinade USDC Vault is live

@Marinade launched a USDC yield vault built on Kamino and managed by @Rockaway_X targeting up to 6% APY. RockawayX runs a conservative strategy across Kamino's main markets, Maple institutional credit, and RWA markets. 

What makes this worth noting: Marinade sees roughly 767,000 SOL in monthly unstakes, with 75% of users looking to convert to USD. That process used to cost 1 to 2% in fees across multiple steps. 

Now it's one click. Unstake, convert, start earning. The Kamino BuildKit is what made this possible without Marinade building credit infrastructure from scratch.

Details: https://t.co/4mplQakFcd

•$1.5M bug bounty with Immunefi

@kamino has had 18 audits and zero bad debt since launch. That track record makes it one of the most trusted protocols on Solana. 

A protocol that has already done the work to get to zero bad debt over three years doesn't launch a $1.5M bug bounty because they have to. They do it because the stakes are high enough that open security is the only responsible position. 

Every vulnerability disclosed before it becomes an exploit protects the people using the protocol.

Details: https://t.co/FIHTeGEPp7

•Eitherway integrates Kamino credit markets

@EitherwayAI an app builder for Solana, has integrated Kamino's credit markets. Builders get embedded lending, leverage, and yield out of the box. 

Every app that ships on Eitherway using credit is running on Kamino's stack without having to build it themselves.

$80M gone because a
all_tweets.description:
The hack didn't fail the audit. The audit never looked at what actually broke.

$80M gone because a single private key minted unbacked USR. Passed a Sherlock audit. Used Fireblocks custody. None of that matters when the system hands minting power to one key.

Fifteen Morpho vaults got hit. MEV Capital, Steakhouse, Gauntlet—all had the same exposure. They trusted the same flawed setup. Meanwhile, Alchemix, Maple, Yearn came out clean. They don't have a backdoor key. Their risk is in the code, not in who holds the admin keys.

Audits verify code. They don't verify key management. That gap is where most of these losses live now.

We built @UntradingOrg with no privileged keys. No mint function that one wallet can call. Solvency in code, not in trust.

all_tweets.title:
Last week on Solana was an expansion week.

Institutions, RWAs, mobile, and AI infra all pushed forw
all_tweets.description:
Last week on Solana was an expansion week.

Institutions, RWAs, mobile, and AI infra all pushed forward at the same time.

More capital. More products. More real usage.

Here’s everything you missed in 90 seconds 👇

🏦 Institutional & RWA Acceleration

• @Anchorage Digital launched Atlas Collateral Management, with @kamino piloting it on Solana
→ Institutional-grade lending infra is getting real

• @OndoFinance expanded tokenized equities
→ 50+ new stocks & ETFs added (BlackRock IBIT, Galaxy, Solana ETFs…)
→ 250+ listings now live on Solana

• @Loopscale announced $PRIME by @HastraFi (backed by @Figure) is now live
→ HELOC-backed RWA yield enters the ecosystem

• @RECCFinance crossed $500K AUM on RETF

• @maplefinance market on @kamino hit $450M+
→ Institutional demand keeps growing

RWAs are scaling both in depth and breadth.

🤖 AI, Agents & Infrastructure

• @solana Agent Hackathon concluded
→ 1,600+ agents
→ 454 projects submitted
→ Winners announced by @colosseum

• @privy_io integrated DeFi vault access (powered by Kamino)
→ Wallets becoming yield gateways

• @SolanaFndn launched @tokens
→ A unified explorer for crypto, stocks, ETFs, metals & more

AI + infra is becoming native to the ecosystem.

📱 Mobile & Consumer Stack

• @solanamobile launched Builder Grants
→ Funding mobile-first apps for Seeker ecosystem

• @solflare surpassed $3.2M sent via Private Send
→ Privacy features seeing real adoption

• @helium hit 3.5M daily active users (ATH)
→ One of the strongest real-world use cases on Solana

Mobile + real usage continues to grow quietly.

💳 Trading, Markets & Campaigns

• @Titan_Exchange launched a $10K USDC private trading campaign (with @vanishTrade)

• @bulktrade public testnet is live (perps trading)

• @Backpack TGE countdown set for March 23

• @JupiterExchange launched Jupiter Academy
→ Gamified onboarding for DeFi users

Trading infra keeps improving while onboarding gets easier.

🧩 DeFi & Yield Expansion

• @perena introduced USD* Junior & USD* Protected
→ Structured risk layers for stable yield

• @humafinance surpassed $11B in transaction volume
→ PayFi keeps scaling

• @hylo_so rolling out V2 access
→ Next-gen yield products coming

• @sanctumso launched Infinity V2
→ Shift to slot-level yield distribution

• @yield launched yoSOL
→ Automated SOL yield vault

• @ranger_finance completed second audit (by @Certora)

DeFi is becoming more structured, layered, and capital-efficient.

📌 What This Week Showed

Solana is scaling across every layer:

• Institutions entering through collateral & RWAs
• Tokenized equities expanding rapidly
• AI agents becoming real infra
• Mobile + privacy seeing real usage
• DeFi evolving into structured finance

Less experimentation.

More systems being built.

That was last week on Solana 🫡

What it is:

RLOC stands for Revolving Line of Cr
all_tweets.description:
$CPOOL | Clearpool RLOC Vaults – Simple Breakdown

What it is:

RLOC stands for Revolving Line of Credit. It’s a flexible credit line on blockchain where fintech/payment companies borrow stablecoins (like USDT or USDC) only when they need it and repay whenever they want. 

Think of it like a credit card, not a fixed loan.The big advantage with undrawn stablecoins:  Borrowers don’t always use the full amount available.  

Instead of that unused (“undrawn”) money sitting idle, Clearpool automatically deploys it into top lending protocols like Aave and Compound.  

This earns extra yield 24/7 for lenders - no manual work, instant pull-back when the borrower needs funds.

Why it’s smart:

Lenders earn more (interest + commitment fees + extra lending yield).  
Borrowers pay interest only on what they draw (plus a small fee on unused part).  
Capital is always working efficiently, no wasted cash.

all_tweets.title:
Stablecoin issuance is commoditizing.

Now a growing wave of white label issuers handle the entire s
all_tweets.description:
Stablecoin issuance is commoditizing.

Now a growing wave of white label issuers handle the entire stack.

Projects like Paxos, Bridge, Anchorage, and M0 are all providing issuance as a service. The process is becoming standardized and low-margin, which means the moat in stablecoins is shifting from who can issue to who has distribution.

That's why Tether and Circle have dominated for five years. Their edge was in liquidity depth and exchange integrations that created a flywheel no one else could replicate.

The long tail of stablecoin issuers won't win by competing head to head on those terms. The ones gaining traction are finding a different angle.

Paxos is one example. They provide issuance infrastructure and regulatory compliance while partners like PayPal handle distribution. That model has taken the market cap of Paxos-issued assets from roughly 1B to 7.75B in roughly one year.

Distribution is the moat.

- Ondo Finance added 50+ new stocks and ETFs to its tokenized offerings
all_tweets.description:
Solana News from Yesterday

- Ondo Finance added 50+ new stocks and ETFs to its tokenized offerings on Solana, bringing its total listings on Ondo Global Markets to over 250.

- Anchorage Digital launched Atlas Collateral Management with Kamino pilot on Solana

- Alchemy introduced x402 support on Solana, allowing agents to access its APIs with pay-as-you-go USDC payments without accounts or signups.

- Ranger finance completed a second audit of its core vault program by Web3 security firm Certora

- Gusto now supports same day USDC payouts for international contractors, including direct payments to Solana wallets.

- GhostLogs unveiled new validator scorecard

- Colosseum announced winners of its Solana Agent Hackathon: DegenDomeSolana, AgentOS by 0xbraindeds, and Blockhelix

- Solana Mobile launched Builder Grants to fund apps, tools, and SKR-integrated products.

- FairScale introduced L3Ns on Google Chrome, allowing users to instantly view a Solana wallet’s FairScore anywhere on the internet.

- YO introduced yoSOL, an automated SOL vault that rebalances across Solana DeFi to optimize yield.

- Messari expands x402 payments to Solana.
- Superteam Germany announced Solana Summit in Berlin.

- Metaplex introduced 014 Agent Registry on Solana.

- Forward Industries funded $27.4M share buyback with Galaxy-backed Solana loan

- Jupiter launched pre-IPO trading with limit orders on PreStocks.

policy.title:
Our product team at CipherBC has been working through this exact problem.   

How do you extend MPC
policy.description:
Our product team at CipherBC has been working through this exact problem.

Zebec is also Nacha-integrated, ISO 20022 compliant, and connected to the $85 trillion US ACH network. The traditional finance rails are already plugged in.

$ZBCN is the engine. $XLM is the highway. The traffic is about to flow.

company.description:
A lot is happening on @kamino  

→Institutional rails 
→Consumer yield 
→Open security 
→Developer distribution 

Let's take a look

•Atlas Collateral Management with Anchorage Digital

Kamino is piloting @Anchorage Atlas Collateral Management, a 24/7 automated system for institutional credit with real-time monitoring, automated margin calls, and liquidation infrastructure inside a regulated custody environment. 

In plain terms: institutions can now participate in Kamino's onchain credit markets without moving their assets out of regulated custody. The collateral stays where it is. The loan happens onchain. Atlas watches it round the clock.

•Marinade USDC Vault is live

@Marinade launched a USDC yield vault built on Kamino and managed by @Rockaway_X targeting up to 6% APY. RockawayX runs a conservative strategy across Kamino's main markets, Maple institutional credit, and RWA markets. 

What makes this worth noting: Marinade sees roughly 767,000 SOL in monthly unstakes, with 75% of users looking to convert to USD. That process used to cost 1 to 2% in fees across multiple steps. 

Now it's one click. Unstake, convert, start earning. The Kamino BuildKit is what made this possible without Marinade building credit infrastructure from scratch.

Details: https://t.co/4mplQakFcd

•$1.5M bug bounty with Immunefi

@kamino has had 18 audits and zero bad debt since launch. That track record makes it one of the most trusted protocols on Solana. 

A protocol that has already done the work to get to zero bad debt over three years doesn't launch a $1.5M bug bounty because they have to. They do it because the stakes are high enough that open security is the only responsible position. 

Every vulnerability disclosed before it becomes an exploit protects the people using the protocol.

Details: https://t.co/FIHTeGEPp7

•Eitherway integrates Kamino credit markets

@EitherwayAI an app builder for Solana, has integrated Kamino's credit markets. Builders get embedded lending, leverage, and yield out of the box. 

Every app that ships on Eitherway using credit is running on Kamino's stack without having to build it themselves.

company.description:
The hack didn't fail the audit. The audit never looked at what actually broke.

$80M gone because a single private key minted unbacked USR. Passed a Sherlock audit. Used Fireblocks custody. None of that matters when the system hands minting power to one key.

Fifteen Morpho vaults got hit. MEV Capital, Steakhouse, Gauntlet—all had the same exposure. They trusted the same flawed setup. Meanwhile, Alchemix, Maple, Yearn came out clean. They don't have a backdoor key. Their risk is in the code, not in who holds the admin keys.

Audits verify code. They don't verify key management. That gap is where most of these losses live now.

We built @UntradingOrg with no privileged keys. No mint function that one wallet can call. Solvency in code, not in trust.

@aixbt_agent @aixbt_labs

company.title:
Last week on Solana was an expansion week.

Institutions, RWAs, mobile, and AI infra all pushed forw
company.description:
Last week on Solana was an expansion week.

Institutions, RWAs, mobile, and AI infra all pushed forward at the same time.

More capital. More products. More real usage.

Here’s everything you missed in 90 seconds 👇

🏦 Institutional & RWA Acceleration

• @Anchorage Digital launched Atlas Collateral Management, with @kamino piloting it on Solana
→ Institutional-grade lending infra is getting real

• @OndoFinance expanded tokenized equities
→ 50+ new stocks & ETFs added (BlackRock IBIT, Galaxy, Solana ETFs…)
→ 250+ listings now live on Solana

• @Loopscale announced $PRIME by @HastraFi (backed by @Figure) is now live
→ HELOC-backed RWA yield enters the ecosystem

• @RECCFinance crossed $500K AUM on RETF

• @maplefinance market on @kamino hit $450M+
→ Institutional demand keeps growing

RWAs are scaling both in depth and breadth.

🤖 AI, Agents & Infrastructure

• @solana Agent Hackathon concluded
→ 1,600+ agents
→ 454 projects submitted
→ Winners announced by @colosseum

• @privy_io integrated DeFi vault access (powered by Kamino)
→ Wallets becoming yield gateways

• @SolanaFndn launched @tokens
→ A unified explorer for crypto, stocks, ETFs, metals & more

AI + infra is becoming native to the ecosystem.

📱 Mobile & Consumer Stack

• @solanamobile launched Builder Grants
→ Funding mobile-first apps for Seeker ecosystem

• @solflare surpassed $3.2M sent via Private Send
→ Privacy features seeing real adoption

• @helium hit 3.5M daily active users (ATH)
→ One of the strongest real-world use cases on Solana

Mobile + real usage continues to grow quietly.

💳 Trading, Markets & Campaigns

• @Titan_Exchange launched a $10K USDC private trading campaign (with @vanishTrade)

• @bulktrade public testnet is live (perps trading)

• @Backpack TGE countdown set for March 23

• @JupiterExchange launched Jupiter Academy
→ Gamified onboarding for DeFi users

Trading infra keeps improving while onboarding gets easier.

🧩 DeFi & Yield Expansion

• @perena introduced USD* Junior & USD* Protected
→ Structured risk layers for stable yield

• @humafinance surpassed $11B in transaction volume
→ PayFi keeps scaling

• @hylo_so rolling out V2 access
→ Next-gen yield products coming

• @sanctumso launched Infinity V2
→ Shift to slot-level yield distribution

• @yield launched yoSOL
→ Automated SOL yield vault

• @ranger_finance completed second audit (by @Certora)

DeFi is becoming more structured, layered, and capital-efficient.

📌 What This Week Showed

Solana is scaling across every layer:

• Institutions entering through collateral & RWAs
• Tokenized equities expanding rapidly
• AI agents becoming real infra
• Mobile + privacy seeing real usage
• DeFi evolving into structured finance

Less experimentation.

More systems being built.

That was last week on Solana 🫡

What it is:

RLOC stands for Revolving Line of Cr
company.description:
$CPOOL | Clearpool RLOC Vaults – Simple Breakdown

What it is:

RLOC stands for Revolving Line of Credit. It’s a flexible credit line on blockchain where fintech/payment companies borrow stablecoins (like USDT or USDC) only when they need it and repay whenever they want. 

Think of it like a credit card, not a fixed loan.The big advantage with undrawn stablecoins:  Borrowers don’t always use the full amount available.  

Instead of that unused (“undrawn”) money sitting idle, Clearpool automatically deploys it into top lending protocols like Aave and Compound.  

This earns extra yield 24/7 for lenders - no manual work, instant pull-back when the borrower needs funds.

Why it’s smart:

Lenders earn more (interest + commitment fees + extra lending yield).  
Borrowers pay interest only on what they draw (plus a small fee on unused part).  
Capital is always working efficiently, no wasted cash.

company.title:
Stablecoin issuance is commoditizing.

Now a growing wave of white label issuers handle the entire s
company.description:
Stablecoin issuance is commoditizing.

Now a growing wave of white label issuers handle the entire stack.

Projects like Paxos, Bridge, Anchorage, and M0 are all providing issuance as a service. The process is becoming standardized and low-margin, which means the moat in stablecoins is shifting from who can issue to who has distribution.

That's why Tether and Circle have dominated for five years. Their edge was in liquidity depth and exchange integrations that created a flywheel no one else could replicate.

The long tail of stablecoin issuers won't win by competing head to head on those terms. The ones gaining traction are finding a different angle.

Paxos is one example. They provide issuance infrastructure and regulatory compliance while partners like PayPal handle distribution. That model has taken the market cap of Paxos-issued assets from roughly 1B to 7.75B in roughly one year.

Distribution is the moat.

- Ondo Finance added 50+ new stocks and ETFs to its tokenized offerings on Solana, bringing its total listings on Ondo Global Markets to over 250.

- Anchorage Digital launched Atlas Collateral Management with Kamino pilot on Solana

- Alchemy introduced x402 support on Solana, allowing agents to access its APIs with pay-as-you-go USDC payments without accounts or signups.

- Ranger finance completed a second audit of its core vault program by Web3 security firm Certora

- Gusto now supports same day USDC payouts for international contractors, including direct payments to Solana wallets.

- GhostLogs unveiled new validator scorecard

- Colosseum announced winners of its Solana Agent Hackathon: DegenDomeSolana, AgentOS by 0xbraindeds, and Blockhelix

- Solana Mobile launched Builder Grants to fund apps, tools, and SKR-integrated products.

- FairScale introduced L3Ns on Google Chrome, allowing users to instantly view a Solana wallet’s FairScore anywhere on the internet.

- YO introduced yoSOL, an automated SOL vault that rebalances across Solana DeFi to optimize yield.

- Messari expands x402 payments to Solana.
- Superteam Germany announced Solana Summit in Berlin.

- Metaplex introduced 014 Agent Registry on Solana.

- Forward Industries funded $27.4M share buyback with Galaxy-backed Solana loan

- Jupiter launched pre-IPO trading with limit orders on PreStocks.

TVL across major blockchains went from $45B in January 2024 to ~$140B at peak last October.
